# Audit Task Template v2 — 19 Mandatory Fields
# ============================================================
# Generated by: Threat Modeler
# Template version: 2.0
# Required by: validate-outputs.sh (task schema check)
# ============================================================
# Instructions: Fill ALL 19 fields. No field may be left empty.
# Fields marked [COPY FROM TASK] must be verbatim from this file.
# ============================================================

task_id: "TASK-{N}-{short-descriptive-name}"
priority: "Critical | High | Medium | Low"

# ── Fields 10-11 (new) ─────────────────────────────────────
flow_id: "FLOW-{N}-{flow-type}"           # Link to flow slice. "none" if no flow mapper run.
phase: "3-foundry-unit"                    # 1-static | 2-flow-model | 3-foundry-unit |
                                           # 4-foundry-invariant | 5-medusa-fuzz |
                                           # 6-echidna | 7-halmos | 8-differential |
                                           # 9-exploit | 10-report

# ── Original Fields 1-9 (unchanged) ────────────────────────

## Target
# Exact contract.function(). No wildcards.
target: "{ContractName}.{functionName}()"

## Execution Path
# The call chain under examination. Every hop matters.
execution_path: |
  caller
  → ContractA.functionA()
  → ContractB.functionB()    # ← note external call (potential reentrancy)
  → token.transfer()

## Relevant State
# State variables that affect the invariant on this path.
relevant_state:
  - "{variableName}: {description of role}"
  - "{variableName}: {description of role}"

## Attacker Capabilities
# What the attacker can do. Be specific about limitations.
attacker_capabilities: |
  {Description of what attacker controls, e.g.:}
  - Can call {function} as any non-privileged address
  - Can deploy helper contracts
  - Can use flash loans from Aave V3 (up to $500M USDC)
  - Can observe and front-run pending transactions

## Invariant
# The property that MUST hold. State it as a formal condition.
invariant: |
  {The invariant, e.g.:}
  totalAssets >= totalLiabilities after every {operation}
  OR
  share_price[t+1] >= share_price[t] for all valid state transitions

## Failure Predicate
# The EXACT condition that proves the vulnerability is real.
# Must be falsifiable. Must be checkable by the Verifier.
failure_predicate: |
  {Exact condition, e.g.:}
  totalAssets < totalLiabilities achievable in a single transaction
  by a non-privileged attacker starting from a valid protocol state

## Required Witness
# What evidence the Verifier must produce.
required_witness: |
  A Foundry test (test_exploit) that:
  1. Starts from a valid initial state
  2. Executes the attack path
  3. Asserts the failure predicate is true
  4. Passes 3/3 consecutive forge test runs

## Completion Contract
# Binary. Done or not done. No "maybe".
completion_contract: |
  DONE if: Verifier produces a passing PoC OR proves invariant holds with
           path-exhaustive evidence (Foundry invariant test passing 10k+ runs)
  NOT DONE if: verdict is INCONCLUSIVE without documented blockers

## Drift Anchors
# 3-5 SPECIFIC keywords. Not "security" or "check". These are checked by drift-detection.
drift_anchors:
  - "{specific keyword 1}"
  - "{specific keyword 2}"
  - "{specific keyword 3}"

# ── Fields 12-19 (new) ─────────────────────────────────────

## Attacker Model
# Explicit constraints on what the attacker can and cannot do.
attacker_model:
  can_be_trusted_role: false          # If true, scope must explicitly include admin bugs
  can_control_oracle: false
  can_flashloan: true
  can_frontrun: true
  can_deploy_contracts: true
  initial_capital_eth: "any"          # "any" | specific amount | "none"

## Token Model
# ERC20 behavior assumptions. Any deviation must be in exceptions[].
token_model:
  assume_standard_erc20: true
  assume_no_transfer_tax: true
  assume_no_rebase: true
  assume_no_blacklist: true
  assume_no_erc777: true
  exceptions: []                      # List exceptions explicitly, e.g.: ["stETH is rebasing"]

## Out-of-Scope Cases
# What NOT to flag even if encountered during reasoning.
# Reduces false positives. Be explicit.
out_of_scope_cases:
  - "Admin key compromise — {owner} is a trusted role"
  - "Griefing with no economic gain to the attacker"
  - "Informational / best practice improvements"
  - "{any other specific exclusion}"

## Stop Rule
# When the Reasoner MUST stop even if uncertain.
# Prevents budget overrun. Must be concrete.
stop_rule: |
  Stop if: 3 consecutive attempts to construct a witness all fail.
  Stop if: A modifier or require() is found that provably blocks the path.
  Stop if: {budget_tokens} tokens have been used.
  Do not: Continue exploring adjacent functions not in the execution path.
  Do not: Generate new hypotheses about other functions.

## Verification Tools
# Which tools the Verifier must use for this task.
verification_tools:
  - "foundry_poc"                     # Phase 3 (mandatory for all vulnerability tasks)
  # - "foundry_invariant"             # Phase 4 (add for accounting invariants)
  # - "forge_fuzz"                    # Phase 4 (add for parameter sensitivity)
  # - "medusa"                        # Phase 5 (add for multi-step sequences)
  # - "echidna"                       # Phase 6 (add for arithmetic properties)
  # - "halmos"                        # Phase 7 (add for safety proofs)

## Negative Memory Check
# Result of pre-generation FP check. Populated by check-negative-memory.sh.
negative_memory_check:
  checked: true
  match_score: 0.0
  matched_pattern: null
  recommendation: "proceed | proceed_with_caution | flag_for_review"

## Economic Impact Estimate
# Rough impact estimate before deep reasoning. Used for prioritization.
economic_impact_estimate:
  asset: "{token name or ETH}"
  max_extractable_estimate: "$0 | $5k | $50k | $500k+"
  impact_class: "direct_loss | value_extraction | griefing | dos | informational"

## Budget
# Maximum tokens the Reasoner may spend on this task.
budget_tokens: 8000                   # Adjust by priority: Critical=12000, High=8000, Medium=5000, Low=3000
